policingExperience.description: Maintain public safety by providing armed policing presence to Perth Central Business District, in collaboration with external agencies. Conduct thorough investigations and present evidence to the Courts.
responsibilities: Respond to emergency calls and provide assistance to the public.
Conduct investigations and gather evidence for criminal cases.
Collaborate with other law enforcement agencies to ensure public safety.

policingExperience.description: Provide specialist roads policing presence to promote road safety and disrupt criminal activity. Respond to traffic incidents and collisions of all severities. Emergency scene management and investigation.
responsibilities: Manage scenes of serious-injury and fatal collisions
Support victims and/or their families
Pursue and apprehend criminal road users
Provide specialist advice to other policing teams

policingExperience.description: Awarded City & Guilds Level 3 Certificate in Learning and Development. All responsibilities of Tactical Flight Officer (below), as well as training and assessment of Constables new to the Tactical Flight Officer role; ongoing development and support of colleagues; and periodical assessment of colleagues in various disciplines including air support operations, crew resource management, use of emergency and safety equipment, and use of night vision imaging systems (NVIS).
responsibilities: Deliver training and assess performance of individuals
Design and produce nationally implemented training material
Proactively seek opportunities to educate policing departments and external agencies on the capabilities and benefits of air support
Adapt delivery to meet individual learning styles
Maintain accurate professional development records

policingExperience.description: Police helicopter crew, responsible for tactical deployment of aerial assets to policing incidents and operations across the southeast of England and further afield as required. Airborne systems operation, navigation, communications, and incident management.
responsibilities: Provide aerial policing response to major and critical incidents
Tactical direction of officers to achieve safe conclusion of high-risk operations
Management and maintenance of aircraft radio communications system software, in collaboration with external agencies

policingExperience.description: Investigation of crime including victim management, evidence gathering, suspect interviewing and court file preparation.
responsibilities: Communicate with victims of crime to promote engagement and understanding throughout investigation
Accurately record and thoroughly investigate criminal matters
Produce evidential packages for presentation to the Courts

policingExperience.description: Respond to emergency and non-emergency calls for assistance from the public, providing reassurance and resolution in times of need. Conduct thorough investigations and present evidence to the Courts. Engage with public to understand community concerns and requirements.
responsibilities: Provide immediate response to emergency incidents
Contribute to public safety and confidence in policing
Accurately record and thoroughly investigate criminal matters

policingExperience.description: Work and learn under guidance of Tutor Constables to complete initial police training, achieving Foundation Certificate in Policing in Partnership with Communities and ‘Independent Patrol’ certification.
responsibilities: Demonstrate understanding of policing fundamentals
Achieve all National Occupational Standards requirements
Contribute to self-development
